ODSFilterChipDropdownItemStories extends the native HTMLButtonElement properties as React props. On top of the additional properties that are listed below, you can also pass the native HTMLButtonElement properties as React props. You can read more about those properties here.

This is a Subcomponent that is used internally on the ODSFilterChip. Should not be used standalone.
